01
characterization

TRPL acquisition

Use a HORIBA Fluorolog-QM with 404 nm excitation and 4 ns IRF. Fit decay curves with a triple-exponential function and calculate the stated intensity-weighted average using the printed equation (2). Individual amplitudes, component lifetimes and fit errors are absent. Inputs denote separate source specimens or datasets, not a physically pooled mixture. Synthesis nitrogen is not inherited by acquisition. Unreported: See source acquisition missingness G5.
